Apartament 1+1 per shitje te 5 Maji!
Ofrohet per shitje apartament i tipologjise 1+1 te zona e 5 Majit, prane Unazes se Vogel.
Apartamenti ka siperfaqe totale 49 m2 dhe siperfaqe neto 43 m2, ne katin e 6 te nje objekti te mireadministruar me ashensor.
Apartamenti eshte i investuar, me hipoteke.
Mundesi shume e mire per investim apo banim!
description_en: 1+1 apartment for sale on May 5! A 1+1 typology apartment is offered for sale in the 5 Majit area, near Unaze se Vogel. The apartment has a total area of ​​49 m2 and a net area of ​​43 m2, on the 6th floor of a well-managed building with an elevator. The apartment is invested, with a mortgage. Very good opportunity for investment or residence!
